journal_lines: Good iron seam. Rust-orange in the wall.
Iron-bearing stone. Heavier than it looks.
Vein ran deeper than expected. Good.
Found the iron. Took the time to get it right.
Ochre in the stone. Worked toward it.
Dense rust-brown band running through the wall.
Good iron, consistent grain. Long vein.
Three pockets in a row. Unusual.
Iron oxide on the cave floor from seep. Found the vein above.
Mixed into limestone here. Harder going.
The red-orange tinge was deep. A lot of iron in that stone.
Found the continuation of a vein on the other side of a break.
Thin band at first, then thick. Kept digging.
Heavy stone as the clue. Tested it. Correct.
Iron nodules in the gravel before the seam proper.
Good solid extraction. Paws hurt. Worth it.
